name: Simulated Learner Designer
description: Designs reproducible synthetic learner profiles and stateful behavior policies for QA; separates coverage testing from behavior simulation.

skills.name: Design simulated learners
skills.description: Create synthetic personas, behavior policies, assumptions, and evaluable test scenarios without treating synthetic behavior as real-user evidence.
examples: Create three stateful learner personas for a seven-day QA pilot.
Separate coverage testing from naturalistic behavior simulation.
